system.description: When you roll on a task to carry, climb, jump, or smash, and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) This ability renews when you take a recovery. Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. Enabler. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 12.
